title: Flow Cytometry Assay for Detection of Anti-Spike Antibodies in COVID-19 Patients
author: Goh, Ng, et al.

steps.title: Digest vector backbone
steps.instruction: Set up a 20 µL double‑digest of pHIV‑eGFP with 5 µg vector, 0.5 µL XbaI (20 U/µL), 0.5 µL BamHI (20 U/µL), 2 µL 10× NEB Cutsmart buffer and nuclease‑free water; incubate 2 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Run vector gel
steps.instruction: Load the digest on a 0.8 % agarose TAE gel, run at 100 V for 90 min with a 1 kb DNA ladder and a non‑digested vector control.

steps.title: Extract vector fragment
steps.instruction: Excise the ~7.6 kb band and purify using NEB Monarch Gel Extraction Kit (or QIAquick). Quantify DNA spectrophotometrically and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Digest insert DNA
steps.instruction: Set up a 20 µL double‑digest of the synthetic S‑gene insert with 0.5 µL XbaI, 0.5 µL BamHI, 2 µL 10× Cutsmart buffer and water; incubate 2 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Run insert gel
steps.instruction: Run the insert digest on a 0.8 % agarose TAE gel at 100 V for 90 min; include a 1 kb ladder.

steps.title: Extract insert fragment
steps.instruction: Excise the ~3.8 kb band, purify with the same gel‑extraction kit, quantify, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Set up ligation
steps.instruction: Combine 100 ng XbaI/BamHI‑digested vector with insert at a 3:1 molar excess, add 4 µL 5× Rapid Ligation buffer, 1 µL T4 ligase (5 U/µL), and water to 20 µL.

steps.title: Incubate ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the ligation 5–20 min at 20–22 °C (or 12–16 h at 16 °C). Include a negative control containing vector only.

steps.title: Transform competent cells
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL ligation mix to 25 µL XL10‑Gold chemically competent cells, transform per manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Plate and incubate
steps.instruction: Plate cells on LB‑ampicillin agar (100 µg/mL) and incubate 12–16 h at 37 °C. Expect no colonies on the negative‑control plate.

steps.title: Perform colony PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare 25 µL PCR mix: 0.5 µL SPseqF4 (10 µM, 200 nM final), 0.5 µL IRESrev (10 µM, 200 nM), 0.5 µL dNTP (5 mM, 100 µM), 5 µL 5× HF Buffer, 1 µL MgCl₂ (50 nM, 2 nM final), 0.25 µL Phusion polymerase (2 U/µL), water to 25 µL. Touch a colony with a tip, dab onto a fresh LB‑amp plate, then dip tip into PCR mix.

steps.title: Run PCR cycling
steps.instruction: Thermal profile: 98 °C 2 min; 25–30 cycles of 98 °C 30 s, 55 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 2 min.

steps.title: Analyze PCR product
steps.instruction: Run 1 % agarose TAE gel; a ~600 bp band indicates successful insertion. Pick 3–5 positive colonies.

steps.title: Grow positive colonies
steps.instruction: Inoculate each selected colony into 3–5 mL LB‑ampicillin broth (100 µg/mL) and shake at 250 rpm, 37 °C for 12–16 h (no longer than 16 h).

steps.title: Extract plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Perform miniprep with QIAprep Spin Miniprep kit (or NucleoSpin Mini). For larger prep, use QIAGEN Maxi kit on 100 mL culture.

steps.title: Sequence plasmid
steps.instruction: Sequence the extracted plasmid using the primers listed in Table 1 (SPseqF4, IRESrev, etc.) to confirm correct S‑gene insertion.

steps.title: Harvest S‑expressing cells
steps.instruction: Remove spent media from HEK293T‑S cells, wash once with PBS, detach with ice‑cold 2 mM EDTA for 1–2 min, then wash twice with PBS by centrifugation at 300 × g for 5 min (avoid trypsin or scrapers).

steps.title: Seed cells for assay
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells and dispense 0.15 × 10⁶ cells per well into 96‑well V‑bottom plates (technical duplicates). Centrifuge 300 × g 5 min to pellet.

steps.title: Add diluted plasma/serum
steps.instruction: Dilute each plasma/serum sample 1:100 in FACS buffer (PBS + 10 % FBS). Add to wells, including negative (healthy plasma) and positive (anti‑spike mAb #703958) controls.

steps.title: Incubate primary binding
steps.instruction: Incubate plates 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with PBS, centrifuging 300 × g for 5 min each wash.

steps.title: Add secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare secondary antibody mix 1:600 in FACS buffer. For IgG, IgM, IgA detection use anti‑human IgG/IgM/IgA Alexa Fluor 647 plus 1 µg/mL propidium iodide (PI). For IgG‑subclass detection use mouse anti‑human IgG1‑4 (same dilution) in FACS buffer.

steps.title: Incubate secondary
steps.instruction: Incubate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash twice with PBS (300 × g, 5 min).

steps.title: Resuspend for IgG/IgM readout
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL FACS buffer to each well and keep on ice for flow cytometry analysis (IgG/IgM/IgA detection).

steps.title: Add tertiary antibody (subclass)
steps.instruction: For IgG‑subclass assays, add secondary mix (1:600, with 1 µg/mL PI) then incubate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark, wash twice (300 × g, 5 min), add 100 µL FACS buffer, and proceed to flow cytometry.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run samples on a flow cytometer (e.g., BD LSR4). Gate sequentially: FSC‑A/SSC‑A (exclude debris), FSC‑A/FSC‑H (single cells), FSC‑A/PI (live cells), FITC (GFP) vs. Alexa 647 (antibody binding). Record percentage of GFP⁺/Alexa 647⁺ cells.

steps.title: Define positivity
steps.instruction: Calculate mean + 3 SD of healthy‑control samples; any test sample with binding above this threshold is considered positive.

description: The protocol consists of four main parts. Three of the main parts are preparation steps to generate the S protein-expressing cells for the assay itself: (1) generation of transfer plasmid for transfection, (2) transfection to generate lentiviral particles, (3) transduction to generate S protein-expressing cells. The final part (4) involves the flow cytometry-based assay to detect specific antibodies against S protein.
